items.title: Generalised fresh-quantified permutation fixed points decompose into freshness and algebraic invariance
items.author: Ali K. Caires-Santos; Maribel Fernández; Murdoch James Gabbay; Daniele Nantes-Sobrinho
items.source_version: FSCD2026 LIPIcs378 article10, official CC BY4.0 publisher PDF; Theorem2.3.5 pp10:7 and its complete appendix proof pp10:21-10:22 with all author supporting AppendixA proof material
items.difficulty_reason: The author combines support equivariance with finite permutation-cycle orbits and nested fresh-name quantification. The non-routine argument turns cycles touching fresh bound atoms into whole-cycle freshness, then separates those cycles from residual algebraic stabilisers while preserving Some/Any semantics across fresh tuples. Both theorem directions and full cycle-support/nested-quantifier proofs are retained. This independent core semantic construction supports H2; support lemmas are not counted alone.
